commuting_square.interpretation: 36 is the affine-triad skeleton; 72 is oriented roots; 45 is cubic triads; 78 is E6; 81 is H1/triple-Albert

theorem_statement: The E6 cubic, firewall, H1, and L-infinity structures fit into a closure square. Starting from 36 affine triads, orientation gives 72 root directions, while adding the 9 firewall fibers gives 45 cubic triads. The same 72-sector closes to E6 by adding rank 6, and closes to H1/triple-Albert by adding the 9 firewall diagonal modes. Thus 36->72, 36->45, 72->78, and 72->81 are four faces of the same finite closure architecture.
interpretive_note: This square is likely the simplest final explanation of the firewall. It is the difference between Lie closure and generation-carrier closure: E6 adds rank 6 to roots 72, while H1 adds firewall/fiber 9 to roots 72. The L-infinity repair appears exactly when one filters away the 9-sector but still expects strict closure.
